description:
Send a test delivery

Sends one signed `webhook.test` payload to the endpoint and reports what happened, synchronously and with no retry. This is a real delivery: it is signed with the endpoint's secret, so it is the right way to check your signature verification. It updates `lastDeliveryAt` and `lastDeliveryStatus` and nothing else: a failed test never counts towards the automatic disabling that follows 25 consecutive real failures, and a successful one neither resets `failedDeliveries` nor re-enables an endpoint you disabled yourself. A transport failure is reported inside a 200 response with `delivered` false, not as an HTTP error.

id.description: Identifier of the endpoint to ping.
